description: Selected causal graphs for downstream synthesis experiments. For each dataset x condition, we pick the threshold whose density is moderate (~0.05-0.18, avg_degree ~2-6), avoiding overly dense graphs (noise) and overly sparse graphs (insufficient structure).

selection_criteria.rationale: Moderate density balances structural guidance (enough edges for the synthesizer to follow causal order) against noise (too many low-confidence edges dilute signal). We aim for avg_degree 2-6, which gives each variable ~1-3 parents on average.

field_anon.rationale: All/Low_Plus (density=0.108) is borderline acceptable but half the edges are Low/VeryLow. Medium_Plus (0.056, 19 edges) retains all Medium+ edges, giving a cleaner structural prior. High_Plus (0.015, 5 edges) is too sparse.

no_anon.rationale: All/Low_Plus (density=0.254-0.269) is too dense. Medium_Plus (0.181, 62 edges) is at the upper boundary but retains the rich structure from domain knowledge. High_Plus (0.064, 22 edges) would also work as a sparser alternative.

field_anon.rationale: All/Low_Plus (density=0.205) is somewhat dense. Medium_Plus (0.137, 47 edges) is well within the target range. High_Plus (0.038, 13 edges) is sparse but viable as an alternative.
